The Bank of Canada today announced that it is maintaining its target for the overnight rate at 1/2 per cent.

The Bank Rate is correspondingly 3/4 per cent and the deposit rate is 1/4 per cent.

Economic data suggest that global economic conditions have strengthened, as the Bank anticipated in its October Monetary Policy Report (MPR).

Following a very weak first half of 2016, growth in the third quarter rebounded strongly, but more moderate growth is anticipated in the fourth quarter.
